correction: Opener passed mailto links to the mail client whole, so a link in a message or a note could carry attach= or other headers some clients act on: the parameter rule assigned to the kit in the review never shipped. A mailto filter keeps only to, cc, bcc, subject and body, compared by their names as written (never decoded, so %61ttach and %74o are dropped), and also drops the fragment: mailto has none, and a client that does not split one off reads ?subject=x#&attach=/etc/passwd as an attach field
